y-m-32-05.s.s3.prompt: Pane ma polynomials maviri, f₁(x)=x²−2x+4 ne f₂(x)=2x²−3x+4, ese anogutsa f(0)=4 ne f(1)=3 (imwe neimwe inopa 4 pa x=0 uye 3 pa x=1). Wana zvasara kana imwe neimwe yapatsanurwa ne (x−1)(x−2), uzvienzanise, uye unyore kuti sei zvasara zvisingasarudzwi kunyange kana uchiziva f(0).

y-m-32-05.s.s3.model.0: Zvasara zve f₁ i x+2 uye zvasara zve f₂ i 3x, saka zvakasiyana. Ese ane f(0)=4 ne f(1)=3, asi zvasara zvakasiyana, saka f(0) oga haigone kusarudza. f(0) ine mutengo we quotient pa x=0 wakasanganiswa, saka haienzani zvakananga ne b yezvasara.
y-m-32-05.s.s3.model.1: f₁=(x−1)(x−2)·1+(x+2) ne f₂=(x−1)(x−2)·2+3x. Ma quotients akasiyana, 1 ne 2, uye kuisa x=0 kunoita kuti ma terms anowanzwa ne quotient ave 2 ne 4, nepo b yezvasara i 2 ne 0. Kana ukawedzera, ese anopa 4, saka f(0) yakafanana. Saka kunyange kana uchiziva f(0), zvasara hazvisarudzwi sechimwe.

y-m-32-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana ne a≠0 ne b≠0 apo (a+b)³=a³+b³ inoshanda. (a=2, b=−2 ne a=−2, b=2 dzinoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwechete.)

y-m-32-07.s.s3.r.c: Kutonga uku kunounganidza nyaya dzose umo musiyano 3ab(a+b) uri 0.
y-m-32-07.s.s3.o.d: Inoshanda kumapeya ose, uye hapana peya isingashande inogona kuwanikwa
y-m-32-07.s.s3.explain: Kune (a+b)³−a³−b³=3ab(a+b)=0, imwe ya a=0, b=0, a+b=0 inofanira kushanda. Peya yekutanga yaChaewon (1, 0) yaiva nyaya b=0.

y-m-32-06.title: Kuenzanisa nzira ina dzekuwana zvasara
y-m-32-06.topic: Kuenzanisa nekutarisa nzira dzakati wandei dzekuwana zvasara
y-m-32-06.goal: Enzanisa nzira dzakati wandei dzedambudziko rimwechete rezvasara, rongedza nzira dzakarurama kubva kune dzine kubhururuka, tonga kuti ndeipi iri nyore kana nzira ichichinja, uye utarise mhedzisiro.
y-m-32-06.material: Wana zvasara kana f(x)=x²⁰−3x+2 (x kune 20th power kubvisa 3x pamwe ne 2) yapatsanurwa ne x²−1. f(x)=(x²−1)·Q(x)+R(x), uye Q(x) i polynomial ine integer coefficients. Vadzidzi 5 vakashandisa nzira dzakasiyana. Nzira A: Nyora R(x)=ax+b, isa x=1 ne x=−1 kuwana f(1)=a+b ne f(−1)=−a+b, uye uwane a ne b. Nzira B: Tora x²=1, shandura x²⁰=(x²)¹⁰=1, uye utore f seyakaenzana ne −3x+3. Nzira C: Sezvo f(1)=0 ne f(−1)=6, tora average yemitengo miviri, 3, sezvasara. Nzira D: Ita long division ye degree-20 kusvika kumagumo. Nzira E: Sezvo f(1)=0, inopatsanurika ne x−1, saka utore kuti inopatsanurikawo ne x²−1 uye utore zvasara se 0.

y-m-32-06.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i nzira yekunyora zvasara se ax+b uye kuisa mitengo inoita kuti divisor ive 0 kuwana a ne b.

y-m-32-06.s.s1.r.c: Funga kana kupatsanurika ne x−1 kuri kwakafanana nekupatsanurika ne x²−1. Tarisawo mutengo we f(−1).

y-m-32-06.s.s1.r.d: Nzira iyi inoshandisa chokwadi x²=1 pamitengo inoita kuti x²−1 ive 0.

y-m-32-06.s.s1.r.e: Kana ukaiita kusvika kumagumo, zvasara zvakarurama zvinobuda, asi inotora nguva yakawanda.

y-m-32-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kune munhu mumwe nemumwe, wanza quotient ne (x−1), wedzera remainder, uye uongorore kana mugumisiro uchiita f.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.hint.1: Isa maremainders aJiho naSua padivi nedivi, enzanisa mumwe nemumwe nedivisor x−1, uye unyore chero musiyano unocherechedzwa.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.o.a: Equation inoshanda, saka vose maquotients nemaremainders akarurama, uye pangava nemaquotients nemaremainders akawanda
y-m-32-09.s.s1.r.a: Fungidzira kana kuongorora kuti equation yechokwadi kwakafanana nekuongorora kuti 'anogamuchirwa sequotient neremainder'.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.o.b: Mhinduro yaJiho, ine quotient huru, yakarurama
y-m-32-09.s.s1.r.b: Hukuru hwequotient hausi mwero. Maquotients evanhu vaviri anosiyana muchikamu chakagara chete.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.o.c: Remainder inofanira kuva 0, saka mhinduro yaJiho neyaSua dzose hadzina kururama
y-m-32-09.s.s1.r.c: Remainder i0 chete kana ichigovaniswa zvakaenzana. Wana kukosha kwe f(1) uye uongorore kana ichigovaniswa ne x−1.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.o.d: Takasimbisa kuti equation inoshanda, asi tinoda kuongororawo mamiriro ehuremu hweremainder
y-m-32-09.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinobvunza kana pane rimwe mamiriro rinodiwa kugamuchira mugumisiro, pasina kumira pakuongorora equation.
y-m-32-09.s.s1.explain: Degree yeremainder inofanira kuva pasi pedegree yedivisor. Remainder x+3 yaSua ine degree yakafanana nedivisor x−1, saka inoputsa mamiriro aya. Saka equation yaSua yechokwadi asi haigamuchirwi se 'mugumisiro wekugovanisa'.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.prompt: Sezvakaita Sua, nyora quotient se x²+x+k uye remainder se px+q. Wana (k, p, q) 3 dzakasiyana dzakadai kuti f(x)=(x−1)(x²+x+k)+px+q inoshanda ne p≠0. (k i integer.)
y-m-32-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzika k imwe uye ugadzire tebhura rekuti coefficient ye x nechikamu chakagara cheremainder zvinochinja sei.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Coefficient ye x yakarurama, saka equation inoshanda.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Coefficient ye x haina kururama. Wedzera (x−1)(x²+x+k) uye uenzanise coefficient ye x ne f.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Chikamu chakagara chakarurama, saka equation inoshanda.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Chikamu chakagara hachina kururama. Enzanisa chikamu chakagara chemutaurire wakawedzerwa ne f.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.ok.c4: Uyu muenzaniso umo remainder ilinear, saka haigamuchirwi semugumisiro wekugovanisa.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.fail.c4: Kana p=0, remainder inogara, saka mugumisiro wekugovanisa. Panguva ino, wana mienzaniso ine p≠0.
y-m-32-09.s.s2.explain: (x−1)(x²+x+k)=x³+(k−1)x−k, saka kubvisa izvi kuna f kunopa remainder (3−k)x+(1+k). Saka p=3−k ne q=1+k. Kana k=2, remainder i x+3 (mhinduro yaSua); kana k=0, i3x+1; kana k=1, i2x+2. Chete kana k=3 p inova 0, iyo mhinduro yaJiho.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.prompt: Ndeapi k mangani anoita p=0, uye nokuda kweizvozvo, mamiriro e 'degree yeremainder iri pasi pedivisor' anoita basa rei?
y-m-32-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kubva pa p=3−k, wana k inoita p 0.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora kana mienzaniso ine p≠0 yawakagadzira nhanho yapfuura ichikwanisa mamiriro.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.o.a: Pane k=3 chete, saka kuwedzera mamiriro aya kunosarudza quotient neremainder kuita imwe
y-m-32-09.s.s3.r.a: Kutonga uku kunobatanidza nhamba ya k ne p=0 nekusarudzwa kuita kumwe.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.o.b: Pane mbiri, k=2 ne k=3, saka dzose dzinogamuchirwa kunyange nemamiriro aya
y-m-32-09.s.s3.r.b: Verenga zvakare kukosha kwe p kana k=2.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.o.c: Hapana k yakadai, saka hapana quotient inokwanisa mamiriro aya
y-m-32-09.s.s3.o.d: Pane k=3 chete, asi mhinduro dzine p≠0 dzine chinzvimbo chakafanana, saka pachine dzakawanda
y-m-32-09.s.s3.r.d: Wakaongorora nhanho yapfuura kuti mwero unogadzika chinzvimbo ndechei.
y-m-32-09.s.s3.explain: Kana p=3−k=0, pane k=3 chete. Saka kuwedzera mamiriro e 'degree yeremainder iri pasi pedegree yedivisor' kunosarudza quotient x²+x+3 neremainder 4 kuita imwe. Equation yoga haisarudze.
